speaker: john_heminges
text: The baskets are still roped. They came over from the Cross Keys, and nobody has talked them into being useful. Edith. Your eight shillings.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I have my account in my hand. I will fold it away before I am glad of anything. Eight shillings arrives better as a folded paper than as a promise.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Out of the stock's share. Not out of a man's part. Lady Day is five days off. I would rather pay a debt with the five days to spare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stock, John. Not my part. I am not moving Saturday's line onto a sleeve.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You are not moving it. I am paying, and I am saying the sentence as I write it. The stock paid a debt, which is not the same as a man drawing his share.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Write it plain, then. My paper is ready to fold. If there is a compliment, it can come after the fold, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will wait for the fold. I have a word on the January sleeve, and it can stand in the queue like a patient man.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: There. Folded. Now you may say the sleeve was a good sleeve. I will hear it as a fact, and not as a reason to wait another month.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The January sleeve held. It was a good sleeve in January, and it is still a good sleeve with the eight shillings no longer owing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, one prince's sleeves, paid for at last.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Struck. The tables have said Edith, eight shillings, owing, Lady Day, since the new year. They can stop saying it.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Good. The old bill is a paid bill. What do you want for Easter, now that January is not standing in the door?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Princess's gown let out. Arthur's hems let down again. Lent has not stopped him growing.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The gown, if the cloth will give. The hems, until there is no hem left to let. A new length is a different bill. Not this one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not this one. This one is eight shillings, from the stock, and a line. The baskets can stay roped.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not paying you from my purse, Edith. John has the stock's coin. Mine stays shut.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I did not ask your purse. I asked the company. The company has come as Master Heminges, which is the right shape for eight shillings.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eight shillings. Five days before Lady Day. If a man tells you the sharers drew it, send him to me.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I will send him to you. The sleeve is a good sleeve. I take the word now the paper is folded and the coin is not a promise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then my tables are clear of you. That is the whole of my part in the hour.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A debt paid by the stock is a quiet line. I prefer those to a speech about a sleeve.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Arthur's hem, and the Princess's gown. I will bring thread for both. I will not bring a fresh bill for the sleeves. Those are finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Finished is the word. Easter can have the gown and the hems. January can stay paid.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five days. I will not have Lady Day walk in and find these eight shillings still a tale we tell.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: It is not a tale. It is folded. Good afternoon, Master Shakespeare. Good afternoon, Master Heminges.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good afternoon. The roped baskets are the company's to ignore. The sleeve is not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eight shillings was the hour. The hour is finished. The stock has done what a man's purse was not asked to do.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: And I have heard the difference. I will not thank a purse that stayed shut for a debt the stock has paid. I thank the payment.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we understand each other. Nothing from me. Eight shillings from the stock. The line is struck.
